title: achyronia nivea
intro: Achyronia nivea, commonly known as Velvet Leaf or White Horse, is a plant species belonging to the family Capparaceae. It is used in traditional medicine to treat various health conditions, such as fever, cough, and respiratory issues, due to its health benefits, which include anti-inflammatory, antimicrobial, and antioxidant properties. The plant's therapeutic actions include soothing irritated mucous membranes, reducing inflammation, and fighting off infections. The bioactive constituents of Achyronia nivea include flavonoids, alkaloids, and saponins, which contribute to its medicinal properties.
